cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A coaches its former race-organizing pupil apology to name the disadvantage of a misplaced start instead of substituting final placing or innocent intent.
confusable: Not demanding generic regret or the trophy: A wants acknowledgment that the race setup unfairly worked against A.
comparison: Starting-position disadvantage versus biased introduction before cake judging.
